spans.s: जुगुप्सन n. 1. Censure, reproach; 2. dislike, aversion, disgust; 3. disgust considered as the feeling which gives rise to the bībhatsa sentiment (in rhetoric); (the S.D. thus defines जुगुप्सा- दोषेक्षणादिभिर्गर्हा जुगुप्सा विषयोद्भवा).

जुगुप्सा f. 1. Censure, reproach; 2. dislike, aversion, disgust; 3. disgust considered as the feeling which gives rise to the bībhatsa sentiment (in rhetoric); (the S.D. thus defines जुगुप्सा- दोषेक्षणादिभिर्गर्हा जुगुप्सा विषयोद्भवा).
